title: 5 Quick Vehicle Checks Before You Hit the Road This Summer in Saskatoon
caption: Summer road trips around Saskatoon are best enjoyed when your car is in top shape. Start with checking tire pressure—Saskatoon’s mix of highway and city streets can affect it—then top off windshield washer fluid, inspect brake lights, and make sure your coolant is at the right level. A quick look under the hood for any obvious leaks can save you a tow later. These few minutes of preventive care help keep you moving and reduce unexpected stops.

title: When You Forget the Oil Change…
caption: You know that moment when the engine starts sounding like a rock band in a Saskatoon garage? Yeah, that’s a sign you might be pushing the oil change a bit too far. Don’t let a noisy engine ruin your day—keep the oil fresh and the ride smooth!

title: The Time a Deer Walked Into My Garage – A Saskatoon Story
caption: Last winter, a curious deer decided my garage was a cozy shelter. While it made for an unforgettable story, it also reminded me how quickly wildlife can surprise you. After shooing it out, I checked under the hood for any curious paw prints or damage. A quick inspection kept my car safe and ready for the next Saskatchewan adventure.

title: Why Brake Safety Should Be a Priority for Saskatoon Drivers
caption: Your brakes are the most critical safety system on any vehicle, especially on icy Saskatoon roads. If you notice squeaking, a soft pedal, or longer stopping distances, it’s worth having them inspected right away. Early attention can prevent a more extensive repair later and keep you confident when navigating winter roads.
